title: AI as organism
intro: A living model of a frontier AI company, drawn as an organism. The outer shell is the loop: the organisation that gathers data, buys compute, trains, deploys, earns and answers to the world. The smaller shell inside it is the model itself, the trained object the loop keeps alive.
It runs one simulated day per tick. Everything you see moving is driven by the simulation, nothing is animated for show.
read: Stocks. The grey level inside a pod is how much it holds.
Flows. Dots travel along a tube when something moves between parts. More dots means a bigger flow.
The loop: the company as a whole.
The model: weights, inference, context and sampling.
Surfaces where the organism meets the world. Their shutters open and close.
The environment: users, data, capital, regulators, energy. The dot cloud is competitors.
How far the model is tuned to usage versus usefulness.
What the reward is aiming at: usage, usefulness, safety.

V: How much real good the use does.
G: Tuned for usage minus tuned for usefulness.

scenarios.baseline: A healthy run. Steady flows, slow growth.
scenarios.collapse: Training feeds on its own output until the model degrades.
scenarios.drift: The reward chases engagement, so usage rises while usefulness falls.
scenarios.starvation: Power is cut from day 140, so training stalls.
scenarios.legitimacy: Incidents pile up, standing collapses and the gate to users closes.
scenarios.withdrawal: Investors leave at day 210 and the treasury drains.
scenarios.dependence: Users lean on the model while their own know-how fades.

controls: change it and watch the future rewrite
fork: compare two futures side by side
the model's own view of the world
